additional_info.subject: ID0425890-DC/Si-D/GR-[MP / ND 170000204] vendorerrorcode "secc is out of order" CRM:02698000169
additional_info.body:
Hello Nikolaos, good afternoon.
I have checked the timestamp you provided and indeed there is a communication error with the AC meter which recovers after a few seconds. This is only affecting the AC outlet and not the DC.
We have already reported this issue and are waiting for a feedback on whether this is a Firmware or Hardware issue.
I will bring you updates as soon as I have a reply.
Thank you for your patience.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0425890-DC/Si-D/GR-[MP / ND 170000204] vendorerrorcode "secc is out of order" CRM:02698000169
additional_info.body:
Hello Nikolaos, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
Feedback from our side, R&D has found the error and it's solved in the next FW 8.X which is estimated to come out in CW27.
Please reach out to Olympia Peratsaki for further updates on this version. If you see any AC outlet out of order, please wait a few seconds/minutes or restart the charger. Usually it fixes itself.
I will close the ticket.
Thank you and have a nice week ahead.
Best regards,
Francisco
